Retirement Annuity — 2/3 Rule & Lump Sum Planner
Two-Pot Retirement System — Effective 1 Sep 2024
How It Works
From 1 September 2024, all future retirement fund contributions are split: 1/3 into a Savings Pot (accessible once per tax year) and 2/3 into a Retirement Pot (locked until retirement). Existing funds stay in a Vested Pot under old rules.
Savings Pot Rules
Access once per tax year. Minimum withdrawal R2,000. Taxed as income (added to your taxable income for that year). Emergency use only — withdrawing early significantly reduces retirement savings.
Retirement Pot Rules
Cannot be accessed before retirement (age 55+). At retirement: up to 1/3 as lump sum, 2/3 must buy an annuity. Same rules as old RA apply.
Cost of Early Access
Withdrawing R10,000 from your savings pot today could cost you R50,000–R100,000 at retirement due to lost compound growth. Think carefully before accessing.

Trust Tax Calculator
Trust Essentials
Letters of Authority
Issued by the Master of the High Court. All trustees must be listed. Required for bank accounts, SARS registration, and property transfer.
SARS Registration
Trusts must register for income tax within 30 days of establishment (IT77TR form). VAT registration required if turnover exceeds R1M/yr.
Section 7 Anti-Avoidance
Income from assets donated to a trust is taxed in the donor's hands if the donor retains a benefit or exercises control.
Beneficiary Distributions
Income distributed to beneficiaries in the same tax year is taxed at the beneficiary's marginal rate (not the trust rate). Properly document distribution resolutions.
Testamentary vs Inter Vivos Trust
Testamentary (Will) Trust
Created on death of founder. Governed by the will and the Trust Property Control Act. Common for estate planning, minor children, special needs beneficiaries.
Inter Vivos (Living) Trust
Created during lifetime. Widely used for asset protection, estate duty planning, and business succession. Taxed at 45% unless special trust status applies.

Klar
Your data. Your control.
Before you begin, here is how Klar handles your financial information.
  • Local-first by default — your financial data is stored only on this device. Nothing leaves without your explicit opt-in.
  • Optional cloud sync — if you sign in, data is encrypted and stored on Supabase. You can delete it anytime from Settings.
  • Optional AI Advisor — sends a financial summary (no raw transactions or names) to Groq's servers in the USA for processing.
  • Optional bill payments — clicking "Pay" opens Stripe's checkout. Klar never stores your card details.
Optional third-party processors:
Supabase (cloud backup)  ·  Groq (AI)  ·  Stripe (payments)
Your rights under POPIA, GDPR & global privacy laws:
Access  ·  Rectify  ·  Delete  ·  Port  ·  Restrict  ·  Withdraw consent
— all available in Settings → Privacy & Data Rights

Klar Privacy Policy

Version 1  ·  Effective 14 June 2026

1. Introduction

Klar is a personal finance management application that runs entirely in your web browser. This Privacy Policy explains how your personal and financial information is handled. Klar is built on a local-first principle: your data stays on your device unless you explicitly choose to enable optional cloud or AI features.

2. Data We Process

Klar processes information that you enter:

  • Financial transactions (amounts, dates, categories, merchants, notes)
  • Bank account names and balances
  • Budget limits and spending history
  • Savings goals and progress
  • Debt records and repayment plans
  • Subscriptions and recurring bills
  • Personal preferences (name, theme, currency)

Klar does not collect: government ID numbers, full bank account/card numbers, biometric data, or SARS/HMRC tax credentials.

3. Where Your Data Lives

📱Local only (default): All data is stored in your browser's localStorage on this device. Nothing is sent to any server. You can clear it at any time.
☁Cloud Sync (optional — opt-in): If you sign in, your data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and stored on Supabase Inc servers. You can delete your cloud data at any time from Settings → Privacy.
🤖AI Advisor (optional — opt-in): When you send a message, a financial summary (average income, expenses, account count, debt count) is sent to Groq Inc for AI processing. Raw transactions, names, and account numbers are not transmitted.
💳Bill Payments (optional — opt-in): Clicking "Pay with Stripe" opens Stripe's hosted checkout. Klar never receives or stores your payment card details.

4. Third-Party Processors

ServicePurposeLocationWhen active
SupabaseCloud backup & syncUSA / EUOnly if signed in
GroqAI Advisor responsesUSAOnly when queried
Lemon SqueezySubscription paymentsGlobalOnly when subscribing
StripeBill payments checkoutGlobalOnly when paying bills

All services operate under their own privacy policies and are bound by applicable data protection law. None are active unless you use the specific feature.

5. Legal Basis for Processing

🇿🇦POPIA (South Africa): Processing is lawful under §11(1)(a) (consent) and §11(1)(f) (legitimate interest) — you are the sole data subject of your own financial records. Local processing may also fall under the personal/household activity exemption.
🇪🇺GDPR (EU/UK): Article 6(1)(a) — Consent for optional cloud/AI features; Article 6(1)(f) — Legitimate interests for local processing of your own data.
🇺🇸CCPA/CPRA (California): Klar does not sell personal information. The personal use context applies. You may opt out of any third-party data sharing by disabling optional features.
🇧🇷LGPD (Brazil): Articles 7(I) consent and 7(IX) legitimate interests. All rights under Article 18 are available in Settings.
🇨🇦PIPEDA (Canada): Schedule 1 Principle 3 — Consent. Data minimisation and accountability principles are implemented by design.
🇸🇬PDPA (Singapore) / Australia APP: Consent and purpose limitation principles apply. No data is collected beyond what you enter for personal budgeting.

6. Your Rights

✅ Access
Settings → Data Management → Full data backup (JSON)
✏️ Rectification
Edit any transaction, account, or record directly in the app
🗑️ Erasure (local)
Settings → Data Management → Reset all data
🗑️ Erasure (cloud)
Settings → Privacy → Delete cloud data
📦 Portability
Export as JSON or CSV from Settings → Data Management
🚫 Restriction
Sign out of cloud sync; remove API key to disable AI
↩️ Withdraw consent
Review consent notice via Settings → Privacy at any time
⚖️ Lodge a complaint
POPIA: Information Regulator (inforeg.org.za) · GDPR: your national DPA

7. Data Retention

You control all data retention. Local data persists in your browser until you clear it or reset the app. Cloud data (Supabase) persists until you delete your account. AI query context is not retained by Groq beyond the API response cycle.

8. Security

  • Local data: stored in browser localStorage, accessible only to the origin serving this file
  • Cloud data: transmitted via TLS/HTTPS; stored with Supabase's encryption-at-rest controls
  • AI data: transmitted via TLS/HTTPS to Groq's API; minimal financial summary only

9. Cross-Border Data Transfers

If you use optional features, your data may be transferred to the United States (Groq, Supabase) and other Supabase infrastructure regions. Supabase maintains GDPR Standard Contractual Clauses. By enabling optional features, you consent to these transfers.

10. Children's Data

Klar is not intended for persons under 18. No data is knowingly collected from minors. If you believe a minor has used this app, please delete all data via Settings → Data Management → Reset all data.

11. Responsible Party (POPIA)

For POPIA purposes, this app operates as a personal-use self-hosted tool. You, as the end user, are the Responsible Party for your own personal information. The app does not have a separate Information Officer — you are processing your own data for personal household purposes.

12. Changes to This Policy

Material changes to this policy will be presented for consent on the next app launch. The version number and effective date are always displayed at the top of this document.
